title: `InitiateOrUpdateSession` typehash is encoded incorrectly
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  According to the [ERC-712 standard](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712#definition-of-hashstruct):  > The type of a struct is encoded as `name ‖ "(" ‖ member₁ ‖ "," ‖ member₂ ‖ "," ‖ … ‖ memberₙ ")"` where each member is written as `type ‖ " " ‖ name`.  In `SessionUpdateHashing.sol`, the `_INITIATE_OR_UPDATE_SESSION_TYPEHASH` constant does not follow the standard, as it includes an extra space between the `deadline` and `session` members.
